question: Among orders that were delivered late, which product category has the highest average delivery delay in days?
agent_sql:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(T2.product_category_name_english, T1.product_category_name) AS product_category,
    AVG(JULIANDAY(T3.order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(T3.order_estimated_delivery_date)) AS avg_delivery_delay_days
FROM products AS T1
JOIN order_items AS T4 ON T1.product_id = T4.product_id
JOIN orders AS T3 ON T4.order_id = T3.order_id
LEFT JOIN category_translation AS T2 ON T1.product_category_name = T2.product_category_name
WHERE T3.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL 
  AND T3.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL
  AND JULIANDAY(T3.order_delivered_customer_date) > JULIANDAY(T3.order_estimated_delivery_date)
GROUP BY COALESCE(T2.product_category_name_english, T1.product_category_name)
ORDER BY avg_delivery_delay_days DESC
LIMIT 1;
gold_sql: SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category, AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_estimated_delivery_date)) AS avg_delay_days FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english ORDER BY avg_delay_days DESC LIMIT 1;
insight: Among orders that were delivered late, the product category with the highest average delivery delay is home_appliances_2, with an average delay of approximately 19.93 days.

question: Among 1-star reviews, what percentage of those orders were delivered late?
agent_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS late_delivery_percentage
FROM orders o
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE r.review_score = 1 
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL 
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL;
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS pct_late FROM order_reviews r JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id WHERE r.review_score = 1 AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;
insight: Among orders with 1-star reviews, approximately 37.87% of those orders were delivered late. This indicates a notable association between delivery delays and the lowest customer rating.
